connectors: the recorded reader's inlet/outlet symbols in predictions/r2-tiles-trace/codex/0-5.json; ids are <manifest sheet index>/<symbol id>
why_not_the_answer_keys: The PID2Graph OPEN100 answer keys (*.graphml) hold symbol classes, boxes and same-sheet edges only: no text and no cross-sheet links. They cannot score cross-sheet pairing.

scoring: precision = pairs in acceptable_pairs / pairs made; recall = continuations with at least one accepted pair / 6. Connectors that print a drawing outside sheets 0-5 have no partner in this set and are not scored.
